description: NCP MP and state president Sunil Tatkare asked on Monday, “We had taken a collective decision to join the BJP-led NDA and people of the state have stamped their approval of Ajit dada’s decision in the 2024 assembly elections. Those speaking of a merger should answer whether they are fine with it.”
title: NCP vs NCP(SP): Bhujbal, Mushrif deny merger talks were on

author: GITESH SHELKE
description: Asked about Parth, Pune commissioner of police (CP) Amitesh Kumar said on Monday: “Our investigation so far has not revealed any involvement.” Although Parth has not been named in the FIR, Digvijay Amarsinh Patil, another of Amadea’s partners, and arrested tehsildar Suryakant Yewale are mentioned. Tejwani and Patil were signatories to the deal last year.
title: No proof of Parth’s role, says Pune top cop on land deal

author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
description: A bench of Justices B V Nagarathna and Ujjal Bhuyan said that there cannot be punishment before trial and directed release of the accused who already spent 18 months in jail. They were allegedly involved in tampering of evidence by swapping blood samples of their kids with their own. Father of the main accused, who is a minor and was allegedly driving the case, is still in jail.
title: Parents to be blamed for allowing minors to drink & drive: SC

author: AJAY SURA
description: On Jan 17, 2019, a special CBI court in Panchkula had sentenced the Dera chief and three others to life imprisonment and imposed a fine of Rs 50,000 for the 2002 murder of Sirsa-based journalist Ram Chander Chhatrapati, editor of ‘Poora Sach’ newspaper. Counsel for Gurmeet Ram Rahim contended that he was not named in the first chargesheet filed by police in 2002 and that his name was included in it “by way of revenge”.
title: Ram Rahim plea: HC resumes hearing in journo murder case

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: The Bangladesh High Court questioned the BCB’s failure to ensure a safe, harassment-free environment for women cricketers. It asked why such inaction should not be declared “unlawful, without lawful authority, and against public interest.” The court ordered BCB to implement its anti-sexual harassment policy and submit a report, following a writ over delayed action on harassment allegations.
title: 'Unlawful': Bangladesh HC questions BCB over female crickters' safety

author: HAMSAVENI N
description: A Bengaluru woman's life was shattered by a brutal dog attack, leaving her with over 80 stitches and deep emotional scars. The unmuzzled rottweiler, allegedly released by its owner, inflicted severe injuries, necessitating extensive surgery. The incident has reignited concerns about responsible pet ownership and the enforcement of safety regulations.
title: ‘Another centimetre and it was fatal’: Rottweiler mauls B'luru techie, leaves her with 80+ stitches

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: A Turkish tech executive has been indicted for defrauding venture capitalists of $7 million in seed money. Gokce Guven allegedly used false financial statements and fabricated documents to secure investments for her fintech company, Kalder Inc. The proceeds were then used to obtain an O-1A "extraordinary ability" visa through similar misrepresentations.
title: 26-year-old fintech founder, Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree, charged with US visa fraud

author: TNN
description: Passengers on a Mumbai-Delhi Air India flight experienced frustration when approximately 40 checked bags failed to arrive at their destination. The airline cited unforeseen technical issues at Mumbai airport for the missing cargo. The flight, AI 2677, landed ahead of schedule, but the early arrival was overshadowed by the luggage mishap.
title: Air India flyers land in Delhi, 40 bags left in Mumbai

author: KALYAN DAS
description: Deepak Kumar, who intervened to protect a Muslim shopkeeper from Bajrang Dal members, has gained significant online fame. Despite facing FIRs for assault and intimidation, Kumar remains resolute, stating he would defend humanity again. The incident has drawn national attention and sparked a debate on religious tolerance and vigilantism.
title: Uttarakhand man who shielded Muslim trader becomes social media star: ‘I will not bow down to hatred’
